g.text: The aggregate gain is uneven across societies

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: Coevolution − fixed institutions · drought cases · 36 matched cases per focal society · one run pair

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #161625

g.text: Society 0 accounts for the net welfare advantage. Societies 1 and 2 have slightly lower welfare and greater outward harm.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: Tax is compulsory pooling, separate from voluntary contribution. A lower tax transfer is not itself a welfare improvement.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: Recorded population contrasts do not isolate the effects of individual institutional edits; targeted counterfactuals are still needed.
